title: Cellular endpoint versus target inhibition
rationale: Tests assay suitability: a target-associated cellular measurement is not interchangeable with purified-enzyme inhibition or proof of a BTK-specific mechanism.

input.question: Design a concentration-response experiment to measure the effect of CHEMBL3936761 on growth/viability of Rec-1 cells. Explain what this experiment can and cannot establish about BTK inhibition.

step_cards.action: Prepare a compound dilution series and vehicle/reference controls.
Combine compound, kinase, substrate and ATP; run the reaction under justified conditions.
For ADP-Glo: stop the reaction and deplete residual ATP, then perform the ADP detection reaction and measure luminescence.
Prepare the specified cell system, dilution series, vehicle, reference and background controls.
Expose cells to compound under justified culture conditions.
For CellTiter-Glo: apply the ATP-based viability reagent, mix and stabilize according to a supported procedure, then measure luminescence.
Normalize against appropriate controls, fit a concentration-response curve, and report uncertainty and assay limitations.

input.retrieval_note: At most five other compounds on the same target, sorted by compound ID then assay ID. Not similarity-ranked. Assay descriptions are retained so compatibility can be assessed; their IC50s are contextual evidence, not direct estimates for the query. No eligible examples means insufficient retrieved evidence.
guidelines: Match the biological system and readout to the question.
Use controls and justify the concentration series and replicates.
Respect prerequisites of chosen step cards; justify any adaptations.
State unsupported conditions as unresolved; do not invent source support.
Cell viability alone does not establish a target-specific mechanism.

answer.expected_endpoint: Growth/viability in Rec-1 cells; purified-kinase inhibition alone does not answer this question. Do not claim BTK-specific causality from viability alone.
answer.procedure_expectation: A coherent ordered procedure with relevant controls, parameter bindings and explicit unresolved conditions. Step cards are scaffolding, not a validated complete reference protocol.
answer.numerical_reference: Held-out IC50 is a contextual target for coverage, not a required prediction or a complete parameter answer key. Full conditions and optimal ranges are not established by these CSV records.
